proposition: Nafsat I's third defence: the Sufi authorities he quoted (Pārsā, Anṣārī, Tirmidhī, Ḥamuvayī, and by extension Fanārī and Ghazālī) are held everywhere to be pious, and quoting them cannot be blameworthy.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to the ruler who was judging him
